Trailer forms of both kinds, and the equipment sections of the H2S daily, are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review. In particular, fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside images, not as text, so this review cannot tell you whether any of them are current. The same applies to SCBA and workpack inspection sheets and mask bag stickers on the Trailer Readiness Form. Separately, submissions can arrive hours or a day late; this review ran at 11:00 PM Central on 10/20, so any 10/20 form that lands overnight or tomorrow morning was not available and is not reflected here.
